You’ll be a clear communicator, naturally curious, process-driven, and detail-oriented. You’ll be capable of translating technical information into meaningful insights for a range of audiences. Technical Proficiency – Solid hands-on experience across Microsoft technologies, including Windows Server and Workstation, Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online), and Exchange Server. Experience with Microsoft Azure (IaaS) is highly regarded but not essential. At Quorum, we believe in work/life balance and putting people first. We have built an inclusive team environment that celebrates freedom and flexibility, with an emphasis on providing opportunities for career progression, and exposure to cutting edge technologies. We're a social bunch that love to stay connected by having regular team and company social events. This focus on company culture is backed by our commitment to achieving our Great Place To Work accreditation for the past six years, consistently being voted in the top 12 workplaces in Australia. Quorum Benefits At Quorum, we embrace a hybrid working lifestyle and provide a range of associated benefits: We understand that a typical 9-5 work week doesn't suit everyone and offer a flexible model that supports true work/life balance. Our comprehensive 'Work From Anywhere' policy takes this flexibility to a whole new level; enabling Quorum employees the option to work overseas or interstate when required. We’re committed to organising regular events and social gatherings to maintain our vibrant team culture, and we have a fully stocked kitchen with a range of food, drinks and snacks, a range of games and amusements (did someone say pool table?), and our awesome free weekly team lunches! The health, development and wellbeing of our team is a key focus at Quorum: We provide a comprehensive range of associated benefits, like paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, professional EAP counselling service, income and life insurance in the case of a personal accident at work, wellness program that offers partial reimbursement of health-related subscriptions (gym, yoga, etc), regular professional in-office massages, a huge range of paid professional training, certifications and development opportunities.
